name: KENT Autosoft 25L
summary: The KENT AutoSoft 25L is an automatic whole-house water softener featuring 25 litres of resin capacity and 5-Step Automatic Regeneration Technology . It effectively removes hardness-causing minerals, prevents scale buildup, improves soap efficiency, protects appliances, and helps keep skin, hair, and clothes healthier.
intro: The KENT AutoSoft 25L Water Softener is a fully automatic whole-house water softening system designed to convert hard water into soft water using an advanced ion-exchange process. Equipped with a 25-litre high-capacity resin tank and Automatic 5-Step Regeneration Technology, it efficiently removes hardness-causing calcium and magnesium ions without the use of harmful chemicals.
features: Prevents scale formation in pipes and appliances
Protects washing machines, geysers, taps, and showers
Helps reduce skin dryness and hair fall caused by hard water
Reduces detergent, shampoo, and water consumption
Keeps clothes softer and prevents fading
